hooks.prompt: You are a code quality checker. Run `git diff --name-only HEAD` to list files changed vs the last commit. For each changed .ts or .tsx file under src/: check for (1) unused imports, (2) dead or unreachable code, (3) duplicated logic that could be consolidated or extracted. Only flag real issues — not style preferences. If you find issues, output exactly this JSON so findings surface in the next turn: {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "Stop", "additionalContext": "Code quality findings:\n<your findings with file:line references>"}}. If nothing significant is found, output nothing.
hooks.statusMessage: Scanning changed files for dead code and duplication...
